# Roadmap

Status: conditional strategic-sequencing owner; not an active implementation campaign.

## Purpose

Use this owner only when several future capability families have dependency-ordered phases whose sequence cannot be expressed clearly by Current Task, Future Capabilities, Future Features, and Campaign plans alone.

## Owns

- strategic capability order and dependencies;
- rationale for why one future phase precedes another;
- candidate Campaign boundaries that are not yet active.

## Does Not Own

- active work, leases, or next actions;
- full feature definitions or backlog inventory;
- completed history or acceptance evidence.

## Baseline Relationship

Extends/Complements: `docs/FUTURE_CAPABILITIES.md`, `docs/FUTURE_FEATURES.md`, and `docs/CURRENT_TASK.md`.

Why separate: `<explain the dependency-ordered strategy that the baseline owners cannot represent without duplication>`
